# Local CapCut snapshot

`CapCut/` contains the requested local copy of the managed CapCut marketplace, version 0.2.5. This directory is ignored by Git and omitted from the release ZIP. It is not installed into Claude Code by the workflow installer.

Use the official installation prompt in the root README to install and authorize the latest published plugin in Codex. See `../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for the distinction between the workflow and upstream code.
